column1: # RTX showcase blocks (notes/RTX_SHOWCASE.md, 11-06): polished stone, tiles, metal plates, a lantern. Glossy things are
# drawn matte-lit here: their shine comes from the material maps (matmaps.py, batches/matmaps.tsv) and the shaders, so
# highlights painted in are small and soft. Frosted, smoked and leaded glass, checker tiles, verdigris copper and the green
# and red glazed tiles are made in code (derive.py). BLOCK_LIKE=limestone_side,slate_side,obsidian,iron_block,gold_block,stonebrick_side_1

column3: polished_limestone|cube|Polished limestone, seamless: one smooth honed pale cream stone face like marble (#baae9a #c6beaa #d2cab6 #e2dccc #f0ebe0), soft thin grey-beige veins (#9a9284 #aaa294) wandering across it in two or three long gentle lines, very fine faint mottling, no slabs, no cracks, no pebbles, calm and even, lit evenly
column4: limestone_tiles|built|Limestone floor tiles: four square tiles of polished pale cream limestone (#baae9a #c6beaa #d2cab6 #e2dccc #f0ebe0), each 15 px with a 1-px grout line between them in warm grey (#7a7266 #8e8678), each tile with its own faint grey-beige veins (#a49c8e) and a soft 1-px bevel, light on the top and left edges of each tile
column5: polished_obsidian|cube|Polished obsidian, seamless: one smooth deep black-violet glassy stone face (#141219 #1f1c23 #2b2633 #3a3746 #454152), faint darker swirls of flow banding, a few tiny paler violet-grey flecks (#6a6577), no slabs, no cracks, calm and even, very dark overall
column6: slate_tiles|built|Slate floor tiles: sixteen small square tiles of dark blue-grey slate (#3a3f45 #4a5058 #5a626c #677278 #7c8790), 4 per row, each 7 px with a 1-px dark grout line (#262a2e) between them, each tile a slightly different shade, a fine cleft grain running across each tile, a 1-px light top-left edge on each tile

column3: copper_block|framed|Copper block: a sheet of polished copper (#863216 #ae4e1e #ca5e26 #de8d51 #ee823a #faa266) with a gentle hammered dimple texture, a 2-px bevelled frame round the face, a small round rivet in each corner, faint soft lighter streaks of polish running diagonally, warm and rich
column4: bronze_plate|framed|Bronze plate: two horizontal bronze panels (#5a3410 #764616 #965a1e #ba7a2e #e2a246 #f6c66a) one above the other, split by a 1-px dark seam across the middle, each panel bevelled with light top and left edges, a row of three small round rivets along the top and bottom edge of each panel, a fine cast texture, a warm golden-brown metal
column5: steel_plate|framed|Steel plate: one sheet of brushed steel (#3e4652 #566276 #5e6e7e #8ea2b6 #b2c6da) with fine horizontal brushed lines across the whole face, a 1-px bevelled frame round it, a small screw head in each corner, cool blue-grey, clean and industrial
column6: glazed_tiles_blue|built|Glazed ceramic tiles: sixteen small square tiles, 4 per row, each 7 px with a 1-px pale cream grout line (#cfc6b0 #ded6c2) between them, each tile covered in a deep glossy blue glaze (#183c6a #24508a #3068a8 #4a86c4 #8cc0e8) whose shade varies a little from tile to tile like handmade tiles, a soft 1-2 px lighter glint in the top-left corner of each tile, the glaze a little darker toward the tile's edges

column3: bronze_lantern|face|Bronze lantern block, a side face: a square frame of cast bronze (#5a3410 #764616 #965a1e #ba7a2e #e2a246) 3 px wide round the edge, a bronze cross bar 2 px wide dividing the middle into four windows, each window of frosted glass glowing warm with candle light (#f6c66a #fbe0a0 #fff2cc #fffbe8), brighter toward the middle, small rivets where the bars meet the frame
column4: bronze_lantern_top|face|Bronze lantern block, top and bottom face: a square plate of cast bronze (#5a3410 #764616 #965a1e #ba7a2e #e2a246) with a raised round boss in the middle 10 px across, a ring of small vent holes round the boss showing warm glow (#f6c66a #fff2cc), a bevelled edge, small rivets in the corners
